
title: "What Are Fama-French Factors?"


# What Are Fama-French Factors?

The Fama-French model extends the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) by introducing additional risk factors that explain stock returns.

## The Original Three-Factor Model

The model contains:

- Market Risk Premium (MKT-RF)
- Small Minus Big (SMB)
- High Minus Low (HML)

## Why It Matters

Empirical evidence suggests that company size and valuation characteristics explain part of stock returns beyond market beta alone.
